```bash
mkdir -p ~/.ssh && cat >> ~/.ssh/config << 'EOF'

# GitHub SSH over HTTPS port
Host github.com
  Hostname ssh.github.com
  Port 443
  User git
EOF
echo "配置已添加"
```
